jobs.title: Practice Director (Consulting) - Data Projects (Snowflake, Databricks, Redis) - Toronto
jobs.description:
Overview

This is an opportunity for a Practice Director
to take ownership of a growing data practice within a specialist technology consultancy. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and delivery — suited to a leader who is equally comfortable shaping a long-term practice vision and rolling up their sleeves to ensure projects land well on the ground.

This is not a purely strategic hire. The right candidate will bring strong delivery credentials, a track record of leading complex software projects, and the commercial and interpersonal skills to build lasting relationships with senior stakeholders. Consulting or professional services experience is a strong advantage.

The Role

Practice Leadership & Strategy

Define the direction and growth strategy for the data practice
Build and maintain a compelling service offering that reflects market demand and client need
Work closely with senior leadership to align practice goals with broader business objectives
Contribute to thought leadership, proposals, and business development activity

Delivery

Take overall accountability for the successful delivery of data engagements across the practice
Maintain hands-on involvement where needed — reviewing delivery approaches, unblocking teams, and ensuring quality
Establish and embed delivery standards, methodologies, and best practices across the practice
Identify and manage risks before they become problems

Stakeholder Management

Act as the senior point of contact for key clients, building trusted advisor relationships at C-suite and director level
Lead client engagement from scoping through to delivery and beyond
Navigate complex stakeholder environments with clarity and confidence
Ensure client satisfaction drives repeat business and referrals

People & Team

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of consultants, engineers, and architects
Create an environment where strong practitioners want to stay and develop
Support recruitment and capability building as the practice scales

About You

A proven track record delivering complex software or data projects, ideally within a consulting or professional services environment
Experience leading a practice, business unit, or delivery function at a senior level
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to operate credibly with technical teams and executive audiences alike
Comfortable moving between strategic and operational work without losing effectiveness in either
A natural leader who invests in the people around them
Clear, confident communicator who can simplify complexity for any audience
Commercially aware with an understanding of how delivery performance connects to business outcomes

If you enjoy delivering projects at pace and are comfortable with executive level stakeholder management in an organisation that is in a strong growth phase, please share your CV by clicking apply. If you have any questions please reach out directly.

jobs.title: VP, Finance and Accounting
jobs.description:
About Advanced Aircrew Academy

At Advanced Aircrew Academy, we help flight departments elevate safety, exceed standards, and stay mission-ready. Through modern training, we empower tens of thousands of aviation professionals to operate with compliance, simplicity, and scalability.

About the Role

The VP, Finance and Accounting leads Advanced Aircrew Academy’s finance and accounting function: accounting, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, finance operations, tax, audit, and the systems behind them. We want a leader who operates strategically while staying close to the details, and who owns the integrity and accuracy of our financial information. You will start hands-on and build the team as the function grows.

You will build a scalable, technology-enabled finance function that delivers timely reporting, strong financial discipline, and decision-useful insight, with workflows where AI does the first pass on reconciliations, variance analysis, and reporting, and people review the result.

As a member of the leadership team, you will partner with the Co-CEOs and leaders across the business on performance, pricing, growth, resource allocation, and investment, and turn financial data into clear recommendations. This is an opportunity to build the finance function of an established, market-leading company entering its next stage of growth in a specialized aviation market.

Primary Responsibilities

Financial Strategy & Leadership . Align financial priorities, systems, and reporting with company objectives, and partner with the Co-CEOs and leadership team on growth, investment, and resource allocation.
Accounting & Financial Reporting . Own the monthly close and financial reporting. Maintain strong accounting practices across recurring and deferred revenue, multi-entity operations, and other core activities.
Planning, Forecasting & Decision Support . Lead budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, financial modeling, and leadership and board reporting, with operating models that connect business drivers to financial outcomes.
Finance Operations, Systems & Automation . Improve and automate billing, invoicing, AR, AP, payroll oversight, and related workflows. Own the finance systems roadmap, using modern technology and AI to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scale.
Pricing, Revenue & Commercial Finance . Partner with commercial teams on pricing and revenue workflows, with frameworks and reporting that strengthen revenue quality, customer economics, and profitable growth.
Compliance, Controls & Fiscal Discipline . Coordinate tax, audit, and regulatory requirements across U.S. and Canadian operations, maintain effective controls and policies, and promote a culture of fiscal ownership and accountability.

What You Will Bring

6+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, in a growing or scaling business. Experience leading a broad finance function is preferred; we will also consider strong finance managers or directors ready to own one.
A track record of building finance systems and processes, including the reporting and operating rhythms a scaling business needs and ownership of a meaningful systems change such as an ERP, planning, billing, reporting, or workflow automation initiative.
Strong accounting fluency, with the ability to run the monthly close yourself, review it critically, and keep reporting accurate. Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and multi-entity or multi-currency accounting; CPA is a plus.
Proven financial planning and analysis capabilities, including bottoms-up budgets, forecasting and cash models, operating models, and leadership or board reporting.
Experience with recurring or contract revenue models, including deferred revenue, pricing, and the financial implications of multi-year customer relationships.
Experience owning external audit and tax coordination, managing external partners, timelines, and compliance across the U.S. and Canada.
AI-native builder mindset, with demonstrated use of AI and automation to improve real finance workflows.
High agency, sound judgment, and executive communication skills, with the ability to work independently, explain what the numbers mean, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce board-ready work.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Expert-level Excel or Google Sheets and hands-on experience with a modern general ledger. Authorized to work in the U.S. or Canada without sponsorship and able to travel across the U.S.-Canada border.

Our Purpose and Values

Purpose
: To be the world’s most trusted aviation training partner.
Values:

Mission-Driven Focus: One life saved makes it all worth it.
People Serving People: Real people, real service.
Change Champions: Advanced means moving forward.
Decide. Do. Deliver: Decisions drive action, actions drive impact.
One Aircrew: Shared responsibility, shared success.

What We Offer

Meaningful Impact . Contribute to a culture where every initiative, innovation, and interaction is aimed at strengthening aviation safety.
Ownership and Growth . Build and lead a modern finance function and partner directly with company leadership on the decisions that shape the business.
Strategic Influence . Help shape how we position the company, reach the market, engage customers, and build the next stage of growth.
Remote Flexibility . Work remotely, with regular in-person collaboration.
Compensation and Benefits . Competitive salary based on experience, plus annual bonus. Medical, dental, and vision coverage, charitable giving match, retirement savings, and a generous PTO policy.
